name: My Foxy Girlfriend
source: The legends of Hazushima Island speak of shapeshifting village protectors—the mighty Kitsune. But when a giant corporation rolls into town to destroy the forest, it's up to you to protect these mythical beings from losing their home.
translation: Hazushima岛的传说中，有一群能够变换形态、守护村落的强大狐妖。然而，当一家大企业来到镇上，打算毁掉森林时，保护这些神秘生灵、守住它们家园的重任，就落在了你的肩上。
